description: This file defines the Currency controller class within the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It handles listing, editing, and managing currencies in the admin interface, including rendering views, processing requests, and interacting with the localisation currency model.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currencies in the OpenCart admin localisation section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the currency list page, process filters, sorting, and pagination, and load the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of currencies, sets up parameters, and returns the view for currency list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies from the model with applied sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the currency creation/edit form, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing currency, redirects after success.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected currencies and redirects back to the list.
